q: After leaving Bramall Lane in 1978, Alan Woodward finished his career in the North American Soccer League with which club?
hint: Woodward scored more than 150 goals from the wing for United before joining Tulsa Roughnecks in 1979.

q: Sheffield United were relegated to the Fourth Division on the final day of the 1980-81 season after losing to which club?
hint: Don Givens' late penalty was saved by Ron Green, and Walsall stayed up at United's expense.

q: Sheffield United won the Fourth Division title at the first attempt in 1981-82. Who was their manager that season?
hint: Ian Porterfield, scorer of Sunderland's winner in the 1973 FA Cup final, took charge that June and Keith Edwards scored 35 goals.

q: Sheffield United still avoided relegation in 1990-91 despite going how many league games without a win at the start of the season?
hint: United had four points from their first 16 games, then won 13 of the last 22 to finish 13th in the First Division.

q: Sheffield United beat Manchester United 2–1 at Bramall Lane on 15 August 1992, in a game that produced the very first goal of the Premier League era. Which Blades player scored it?
hint: Deane scored twice that afternoon, one of them from the penalty spot, and his opener was the first goal the new competition ever saw.

q: On the opening day of the first Premier League season in August 1992, Sheffield United won 2–1 at Bramall Lane against which club?
hint: The visitors went on to win that inaugural Premier League title, but they lost their opening fixture in Sheffield in front of 28,070.

q: Sheffield United contest the Steel City derby with which club?
hint: The two Sheffield clubs sit a few miles apart — Wednesday at Hillsborough, United at Bramall Lane.

q: Chris Wilder's first season in charge, 2016–17, ended with Sheffield United winning the League One title. How many points did they finish on?
hint: Wilder, a boyhood Blade, ended a six-season stay in the third tier at the first attempt — and the Blades reached three figures.
